name: Necrons (Hypercrypt Legion)
note: App export (newrecruit.eu v35.82), 2000 pts. 13 list entries, 9 units after four attachments. Hypercrypt Legion alone is 2 of the 3 DP, and Reconnaissance is the one Force Disposition it grants, so the Primary Mission is Reconnaissance Sweep. Engine total 1990 against the export's 2000: two known deviations, both already on verify_rules_vs_engine.py's report - Plasmancer 55 (printed 60) and Skorpekh Lord 90 (printed 95) - and the engine's transcribed points win, as for every other list. No Enhancement is bought. The export names the Overlord WARLORD; nothing in this engine reads a Warlord (a documented no-op), so it is recorded here and nowhere else. Its SECONDARY line (Bring It Down, Assassination, Cull The Horde) is an app scoring summary, not list data - this engine deals Secondaries from its own deck.
